finding.claim: Remote embed HTML is emitted unescaped, bypassing html_input=strip|escape. If an attacker controls the HTML returned for an embed URL (no allowlist, or an allowlisted multi-tenant domain such as a *.github.io subdomain), that HTML is rendered as stored XSS for every viewer.
finding.source: Markdown line containing only an https:// URL (src/Extension/Embed/EmbedStartParser.php:34-51), fetched remotely and stored via src/Extension/Embed/Bridge/OscaroteroEmbedAdapter.php:46 (setEmbedCode from $extractor->code->html).

trace.note: Requires https:// prefix; author-supplied URL is accepted.
Domain filter applied only when allowed_domains is non-empty (default []).
Suffix match '.'.domain accepts any subdomain of an allowlisted domain.
Remote code->html stored as embed code with no sanitization.
Raw embed code returned as node output.
html_input filter is not applied to embed nodes.

finding.guards_checked: https-only prefix; DomainFilteringAdapter parsed-host check (correct for @ and # tricks, but suffix-based, so multi-tenant subdomains pass); html_input filter (not applied to Embed nodes); allow_unsafe_links (not applicable). The external embed/embed library's HTML extraction is not in the repo and is unverified.

finding.claim: With the default empty allowed_domains, the embed adapter performs server-side fetches to any https URL an author supplies, enabling SSRF to internal https hosts. Response data reaches output only via the embed code, so impact is mostly a reachability oracle.
finding.source: Any Markdown author; any https:// line in a document when EmbedExtension is registered without allowed_domains.
finding.sink: src/Extension/Embed/Bridge/OscaroteroEmbedAdapter.php:43 calls getMulti on the attacker-supplied URLs.

trace.note: Filter skipped when allowlist is empty.
All embed URLs are passed to the adapter.
Remote fetch of attacker-supplied URLs with no private-IP, redirect or rebinding control in this repo.

finding.guards_checked: https-only prefix only. No private, loopback or link-local IP blocking, no IP pinning, and no redirect control in this repo. Library-side behavior is unverified.
